mapper.select: select * from tcc_schedule order by schedule_date desc
select * from tcc_price where schedule_idx = #{schedule_idx} order by price_price asc limit 1

select board_idx , board_config , board_conidx , board_name , board_contents , board_attachName , board_attachPath , date_format(board_regdate, '%Y.%m.%d') as board_regdate , board_readcount , mem_idx from tcc_board where board_config = #{boardConfig} order by board_regdate desc limit 4
